text:
Three coloured inks, P, Q and R, are tested using paper chromatography.
The chromatogram is shown.
P
Q
R
Which statement is correct?
A
P is a pure substance.
B
P and Q have a colour that could be the same in both inks.
C
The top line of the chromatogram is called the baseline.
All the colours inR are also in Q.
D

options.label: B
options.text: P and Q have a colour that could be the same in both inks.

options.label: C
options.text: The top line of the chromatogram is called the baseline.

options.label: D
options.text: All the colours inR are also in Q.
